details:
Course Description

Power BI is used for business intelligence (BI), transforming raw data from various sources into interactive, visual reports and dashboards to help people understand trends, make data-driven decisions, and monitor performance across an organization, from sales to operations, using features like AI insights and self-service analytics. It allows users to connect to data, clean and model it, create visualizations (charts, maps, graphs), and share these insights easily within apps or the web.

excerpt: Data analytics converts raw data into actionable insights. It includes a range of tools, technologies, and processes used to find trends and solve problems by using data. Data analytics can shape business processes, improve decision-making, and foster business growth.
details:
Course Description

Data analytics is the process of collecting, transforming, and organizing data to derive actionable insights, predict trends, and inform business decisions. It encompasses techniques like data mining, machine learning, and visualization to optimize performance and efficiency, often categorized into descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive types.

Key Aspects of Data Analytics
  • Descriptive: Analyzes historical data to understand what happened.
  • Diagnostic: Investigates data to understand why something happened.
  • Predictive: Uses historical data to forecast future outcomes.
  • Prescriptive: Recommends specific actions based on predictive insights.
The Process

Data analytics involves identifying requirements, collecting data,cleaning/processing it, analyzing it, and sharing findings through visualizations.

Key Tools

Popular tools include Python, R, SQL, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, Apache Spark, and SAP Analytics Cloud.

excerpt: Rivets are essential fasteners used in construction and manufacturing to join materials together securely. They provide strength, durability, and structural integrity, making them indispensable in various industries such as aerospace, automotive, and engineering.
details:
Course Description

A rivet is a permanent mechanical fastener used to join two or more materials, such as metal, plastic, or leather. It consists of a smooth cylindrical shaft (the shank) with a pre-formed head on one end and a tail on the other.
